Short answer: If the call is in November (after the US switch), 9:00 AM New York = 2:00 PM London. The UK switched back to GMT on 25 October 2026 and the US switched back on 1 November 2026, so by November both cities are on standard time. ([gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/when-do-the-clocks-change?hss_channel=tw-89465662&utm_source=openai)) ([timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/time/change/uk?utm_source=openai))

Two-line note you can send to London attendees:
Quick heads-up: our recurring 9:00 AM ET call in November will be at 2:00 PM in London (GMT).  
Please let me know if that new time causes any issues — thanks.
